mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Toss_t(id, orderId, orderName, amount, approvedAt, provider, statusCount, remainCount, payStatus, cancelReason, canceledAt, paymentKey) VALUES(#{id}, #{orderId}, #{orderName}, #{totalAmount}, #{approvedAt}, #{provider}, #{statusCount}, #{statusCount}, #{payStatus}, #{cancelReason}, #{canceledAt}, #{paymentKey})
mapper.update: update User_t set payCount = payCount + #{statusCount} where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select t.statusCount, u.payCount from Toss_t as t join User_t as u on u.id = t.id where u.id=#{id} and t.t_idx=#{t_idx}
select t.*, u.* from Toss_t as t join User_t as u on u.id = t.id where u.id=#{id} and t.id=#{id} order by t.t_idx desc
